evidence.title: Preventive care
evidence.text: One annual preventive visit with an in-network primary care provider is covered at no cost share when billed as preventive. Other services during the visit may be billed separately.

speak: Dr. Haddad's office number is 212-555-0102. Your plan passage covers one annual in-network preventive visit when billed as preventive; other services may be billed separately.
